comments.author: Shubham Saboo
comments.comment:
Most agent failures are harness bugs, not model bugs. Bad tool permissions, stale context, and missing verifiers cause more pain than weak models. I debug traces before swapping models. What harness check has saved you the most production pain?

#AgentHarness #LLMOps #AIEvals

comments.author: Finley Topping
comments.comment:
I’d gate this less by department and more by audit trail: every clause flag needs source text, version, and a human sign-off checkpoint. Which of the 24 agents produces the most false positives in real contracts, and how are you measuring that?

#AgenticAI #LegalTech #Evals

comments.author: NVIDIA AI
comments.comment: Agent traces are not just eval logs; they're the execution graph. If NeMo Relay captures runtime state and handoffs, you can separate a bad tool result from a bad agent decision. How do you score the policy when the tool is correct but the agent still misroutes? #AgenticAI
